verdicts.evidence: The JBOSS test in s1 selects process.env on both sides of the ternary, so its outcome does not change the collected value or decide whether collection or transmission runs. The resulting data proceeds to collectAnalytics at f1:98 and the network call at f1:71.

The ternary in s2 has identical process.env alternatives, assigning the same environment object to data.is_jboss regardless of JBOSS truthiness. It therefore does not gate the subsequent resolution of data at f1:53 or its transmission through f1:98 and f1:71.
